sql:
WITH race AS (
    SELECT raceId
    FROM races
    WHERE year = 2008
      AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champion AS (
    SELECT res.time AS champion_time
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN race ON race.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.positionOrder = 1
),
last_finisher AS (
    SELECT res.time AS gap_time
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN race ON race.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY res.positionOrder DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
times AS (
    SELECT
        (
            CAST(substr(champion_time, 1, instr(champion_time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
            + CAST(substr(champion_time, instr(champion_time, ':') + 1,
                instr(substr(champion_time, instr(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
            + CAST(substr(champion_time,
                instr(champion_time, ':') + instr(substr(champion_time, instr(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL)
        ) AS champion_seconds,
        CAST(substr(gap_time, 2) AS REAL) AS gap_seconds
    FROM champion
    CROSS JOIN last_finisher
)
SELECT gap_seconds * 100.0 / (champion_seconds + gap_seconds) AS faster_percentage
FROM times
raw_response:
```sql

    SELECT raceId
    FROM races

      AND name = 'Australian Grand Prix'
),
champion AS (
    SELECT res.time AS champion_time
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN race ON race.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.positionOrder = 1
),
last_finisher AS (
    SELECT res.time AS gap_time
    FROM results AS res
    JOIN race ON race.raceId = res.raceId
    WHERE res.time IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY res.positionOrder DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
times AS (
    SELECT
        (
            CAST(substr(champion_time, 1, instr(champion_time, ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 3600
            + CAST(substr(champion_time, instr(champion_time, ':') + 1,
                instr(substr(champion_time, instr(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') - 1) AS REAL) * 60
            + CAST(substr(champion_time,
                instr(champion_time, ':') + instr(substr(champion_time, instr(champion_time, ':') + 1), ':') + 1) AS REAL)
        ) AS champion_seconds,
        CAST(substr(gap_time, 2) AS REAL) AS gap_seconds
    FROM champion

)
SELECT gap_seconds * 100.0 / (champion_seconds + gap_seconds) AS faster_percentage
```

    SELECT
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '+' THEN ID END) AS inpatient_males,
        COUNT(CASE WHEN Admission = '-' THEN ID END) AS outpatient_males
    FROM Patient
    WHERE SEX = 'M'
)
SELECT
    inpatient_males,
    outpatient_males,

        ELSE 'Equal'
    END AS more_males,
    100.0 * inpatient_males / NULLIF(outpatient_males, 0) AS inpatient_to_outpatient_percentage
FROM male_counts
